Current exact-source update (`f22dc025`, development branch, 2026-10-15): the original trace/Jacobi test remains incomplete. After the fixture was changed to release each precision rung's Vulkan device separately, the new attempt stopped at the unchanged sampled aggregate host-RSS guard: 4,196,456 KiB versus 4,194,304 KiB (2,152 KiB excess), owner time 137.325402941 s, child terminated with -15. Only `module=trace.spv phase=begin` was recorded: no prepared/exercised marker, later rung, XML or numerical verdict. This first-rung stop excludes retention of later-rung resources as its explanation; it does not identify the allocating/JIT call. The earlier `e0db7d59` attempt had no rung markers and its phase remains unknown. Original 300-second/4-GiB/2-GiB-reserve guards, focused LVP0/default-cache settings, assertions and submission limits were preserved. Source and all 1,297 inputs stayed exact; root and independent ownership audits passed. [Published first-rung stop/source reviews](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/def305c1da0e26a5be1f4fac61fb80974a301829/attestations/scientific-core/f22dc025/trace-jacobi-first-rung-rss-stop). No unchanged retry or guard increase is admitted. A separate two-pair loop hypothesis is source-reviewed and unapplied; its offline compiler screen is being admitted, with no emitted-code or runtime benefit yet established.

All eleven original focused E2 CPU witnesses passed separately at `f22dc025`, including the original real polarisation session, independent domain/Walker–Penrose checks and disk transport witnesses. All original assertions and diagnostic guards were unchanged. [Published eleven-case CPU evidence and five genuine current Linux test ELFs](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/34a94cd5b367dfdb9b62f71be693bf1e80bf7781/attestations/scientific-core/f22dc025/e2-original-eleven-cpu-witnesses).

Fifteen additional original CPU witnesses also passed: near-extremal oracle/live conservation, analytic/live radial and circular beam checks, 100000-star finite flicker/catalogue-index checks, oracle/live truncated Page–Thorne edges, pupil/four-dimensional sampling, HDR round-trip and film/linear-EXR-path isolation, nine finite CPU metric frames and missing-ICD CPU publication. Exact XML/owner/input/guard/writer records passed independent completion and preservation review. [Published fifteen-case science evidence](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/031ef445c036fb5bcbce91da4c8ca8c45ccc9c56/attestations/scientific-core/f22dc025/original-fifteen-cpu-science-witnesses). Catalogue bounds are finite CPU witnesses; the physical 1920×1080/5616×4096 Radeon scenes and 2-GiB device requirement remain open. Film checks compare display/linear-path snapshots, with no retained EXR-byte identity claim. Fast cases with zero samples have unobserved RSS peaks.

[Current CI 38776590607](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/38776590607) passed the three requested integration jobs and both original 9/9 native-build gates with all 1,152 registrations. [Published current CI evidence](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/c8bc52bbea5fd0e4b1a56b42bd1f2af3770eddc8/attestations/qualification/f22dc025/native-build-ci-38776590607) remains build evidence; compiled external-domain admission is 0/8. The earlier eight software controls, seven native AMD controls and four-column RK4 execution below retain their own exact historical revisions. Full P1–P6/E1–E4, remaining fields/transport/consumers, full Mandatory, original cold frame/latency gates, physical/native UI scenes, original July-image identity, external runtime domains and installed-release qualification remain open.

Prior entry retained verbatim (last updated 2026-10-15 17:14 UTC; describes `e0db7d59`):

The original `KernelTrace.ActualTraceClipsJacobiAndRetainsInvalidSamplesAcrossRungs` attempt at `e0db7d59` is incomplete at its unchanged sampled aggregate 4 GiB RSS guard: owner time 188.782222342 s, peak 4,203,496 KiB versus the 4,194,304 KiB limit (9,192 KiB excess), child terminated with -15. No XML, completed precision rung or final numerical verdict was produced; no positive collector was run. The stop does not identify a failed numerical assertion, unsupported FP64 or the allocating driver phase. Source and all 621 inputs remained exact; actual same-birth LVP0/default-cache environment/provider mapping and scoped teardown passed independent ownership audit. [Preserved original attempt and reviews](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/5cc46b727d53603e919727aec110cfd12108a560/attestations/scientific-core/e0db7d59/trace-jacobi-source-and-software-rss-stop).

The separately accepted eight focused software controls, seven native AMD controls and original four-column RK4 witness below remain scoped to their own executions. This new trace/Jacobi result supplies no P2 pass. No unchanged retry or guard increase is admitted. The fixture retains earlier-rung Vulkan resources until its single device is destroyed; that source fact is being investigated without attributing the observed stop to it. Broader scientific, cold-frame, Mandatory and release obligations remain open.

Earlier exact-revision update retained verbatim (2026-10-15):

Current exact-source update (`e0db7d59`, development branch): all eight original focused software-Vulkan controls now pass with zero failures/errors/skips/disabled tests. This includes the previously incomplete FP64 precision-invariants case, which completed in 268.394 s with `native_invariants_executed`. The external 300-second / aggregate 4 GiB RSS / available-memory reserve 2 GiB guards, original assertions and physical submission limits were unchanged. Default shader cache and explicitly observed `LVP_JIT_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL=0` are the focused diagnostic settings. [Preserved eight-case/source evidence](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/2c419ad2f420a50ebb6cc92c37ef0cc30927a63d/attestations/scientific-core/e0db7d59/kerr-cartdelta-rhs-source-and-software-controls).

All seven original selected native AMD controls also pass at this revision: three minimum-step retries, both captured-state endpoints, the original 64×64 Kerr image and the real FP32/FP64 image comparison. Image shadow fraction is `0.109375`, luminance `[0,0.874792]`; comparison mean absolute difference `1.63447e-7`, maximum `7.92742e-6`, black pixels `448/448`. Exact source/products/predecessor inputs, actual child SDK-loader/AMD mappings and dated birth-scoped teardown passed root and independent review. PID reuse is distinguished from owned-birth absence; these records do not establish global Windows absence. No raw framebuffer was saved. [Preserved seven-case native evidence](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/f8e2064c8cbd6b8df362d012e5d4fbccd329efa0/attestations/scientific-core/e0db7d59/native-amd-kerr-cartdelta-rhs-controls).

The unchanged original `FourColumnRK4MapMatchesIndependentNeighboursFp64` witness also passes: one completed zero-FESD test with the actual FP64 joint-map/scalar-neighbour property, seven accepted scenes and two negative packets. Test time was 44.272 s; all nine real submissions were 1.438038–2.869936 ms under their original 1000 ms cap. The separate software zero-active initialization took 36165.885915 ms and has no original 1000 ms cap. All 616 inputs remained exact, peak sampled aggregate RSS was 1,067,992 KiB, and actual LVP mapping/environment and saved-birth teardown passed independent review. No raw GPU result array was saved. [Preserved original coupled witness](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/4fea48f0797f3f905310e7555b1071bf54a2a528/attestations/scientific-core/e0db7d59/coupled-rk4-original-witness).

[CI 38754177960](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/38754177960) passed the three requested build/integration jobs; Windows/macOS native build gates passed 9/9 and retained all 1,152 registrations. Five unrequested qualification jobs were skipped. [Preserved exact CI products](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/d0662d27ef039c2a83aa43f6e7df57cd89f9fe76/attestations/qualification/e0db7d59/native-build-ci-38754177960) are build evidence. Current compiled external-domain admission remains 0/8. Full P1–P6/E1–E4, all 40 physical fields and remaining transport/consumer witnesses, full Mandatory, original cold 128×128/300-second frame, native preview/UI/scenes, original July-image identity, external runtime domains and release qualification remain open. These finite passes establish no retained-renderer latency or performance benefit. The next original trace/Jacobi witness is only being admitted; no result is claimed here.

Historical update retained verbatim below (superseded only by the exact-revision results above; retained 2026-10-15):

Update for exact source `cd99fd06`: all seven selected native AMD controls pass—FP32/COMP/FP64 minimum-step retries, both captured-state endpoint regressions, the original 64×64 Kerr image, and the original real FP32/FP64 image comparison. Each completed one test with zero failures/errors/skips/disabled tests. Image shadow fraction was `0.109375`, luminance `[0,0.874792]`; comparison mean absolute difference `1.66903e-7`, maximum `1.07288e-5`, black pixels `448/448`. Source/product/predecessor inputs, same-child staged SDK-loader/AMD module records, postseals and birth-scoped teardown passed root and independent audits. No raw framebuffer was saved. [Preserved current seven-case evidence](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/4767db8a07560ee3eea39aadc8b3490ade903f58/attestations/scientific-core/cd99fd06/native-amd-kerr-shared-loop-controls).

The shared coarse/fine loop introduced by `2904edbf` materially reduced the emitted probes. Its software-Vulkan sequence completed the first seven controls under the unchanged aggregate 4 GiB / reserve 2 GiB / 300-second diagnostic limits with default cache and explicitly recorded focused `LVP_JIT_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL=0`. The eighth, `PrecisionRungsConserveNearExtremalKerrWithoutImageComparison`, stopped at the external 300-second guard with no XML or final numerical verdict; it remains incomplete. Native passes do not replace that result. [Preserved source/software controls](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/b5c4f2a8247b55d91c274aaeb7bb41ca9dfabf8e/attestations/scientific-core/cd99fd06/kerr-shared-loop-source-and-software-controls).

[CI 38735683288](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/38735683288) passed all three requested integration jobs. Native build gates passed 9/9 on Windows/macOS and both inventories retained all 1,152 registrations. Five unrequested qualification jobs were skipped. [Exact products and provenance](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/449a5ad7ad22e194bf60ce32dd19de40ff034929/attestations/qualification/cd99fd06/native-build-ci-38735683288) are build evidence. Full science/P1–P6, all 40 fields, full Mandatory, the original cold 128×128/300-second frame, viewer, original forensic-image identity, external runtime domains and release qualification remain open. The historical failure, fix and prior results below remain scoped to their named revisions.

The original native Radeon 780M case at `02ee51f` completed with one `MinimumStep` failure at pixel `(24,23)`: attempt 100, 89 accepted steps, original `.02f` floor. No image was published. Host-only context logging changed no shader or scene settings. All physical/source/volume/identity bytes remained unchanged across the rejected attempt; all 100 bound inputs and 101 whole-map entries stayed stable. Actual child SDK-loader/AMD mappings and postseals joined, and recorded owner/test/auditor births were retired. Capture/ownership acceptance is not a numerical pass.

Independent committed-state algebra gives normalized null residual ≈1.04114e-7 and radius ≈1.62273165089, outside the buffered capture radius ≈1.60819674366. A norm-preserving local canonical reference at 32/64/128 substeps and two finite-difference epsilons finds a sampled inward capture crossing near affine 0.014961783562, before the original 0.019999999553 floor interval ends. The 64→128 endpoint-radius difference is ≈2.03e-12. These are observed refinements and numerical event brackets, not certified error bounds or full-ray qualification.

An independent ideal Cartesian RK4 calculation at the saved state gives the original full-versus-two-half-step scale ratio ≈2.10657 against the unchanged integration bound. Its two-half-step unprojected normalized null residual ≈2.05039e-6 is below the original null bound. This exposes a mathematical truncation limit at the requested floor; actual hidden GPU trial data and its exact rejection conjunct remain unavailable. Source `ed764546` now selects independent fixed composite RK4 meshes before a single counted exact-floor attempt: coarse/fine 2/4 for FP32/COMP, 32/64 for FP64. It covers the original total policy interval and preserves the error/null predicates, projection, floor/rejection rules, ABI and physical dispatch caps. This now passes the finite native controls below; broader P1 and horizon coverage remain open.

Preserved evidence: [raw capture](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/2b654bb1c05df655db6d960a908e9ed7e1bf8a91/attestations/scientific-core/02ee51f/native-amd-kerr-failure-context), [state algebra](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/876075bb7cf3b092712dfa7c685449f3963c4bb9/attestations/scientific-core/02ee51f/kerr-committed-state-analysis), [local canonical reference](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/b3c57f4d59e27b40a74c923b2fc246ef6526623b/attestations/scientific-core/02ee51f/kerr-local-hamiltonian-reference), [Cartesian diagnostic](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/a3b375933d805fc0affd7c8cb56405296d89d261/attestations/scientific-core/02ee51f/kerr-cartesian-floor-diagnostic).

The two new captured-state regressions compare the projected shader endpoint against both immutable unprojected canonical128 reference channels, using the original `2e-5f` bound with no added projection allowance. All prior P1 requirements/evidence remain, and the tests join live Mandatory registration. Strict GCC and source-governance checks passed. The first software-Vulkan regression was stopped by its original aggregate 4 GiB diagnostic RSS guard after 257.311 s (peak 4,204,320 KiB); no XML, shader result or numerical verdict was produced. Seven later software controls remain unrun; there is no unchanged software retry. [Reviewed source and bounded stop](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/4a7cb7f3f74b9ead89b42ae2c4eeebd8535ca014/attestations/scientific-core/ed764546/kerr-floor-composite-source-and-software-rss-stop).

Exact-source integration [CI 38724081383](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/38724081383) passed on Windows/macOS/Linux. Both native build gates passed 9/9 with zero failures/errors/skips and 1,152 registrations; all prior 1,150 names/labels/timeouts are preserved. [Current CI products and provenance](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/86c368e55380247a7854493cb86a721259a7ce53/attestations/qualification/ed764546/native-build-ci-38724081383) are build-only evidence. These build records remain distinct from the finite native AMD runtime evidence below. Full science/Mandatory, horizon-domain coverage, viewer and release qualification remain open.

All seven selected native Radeon 780M cases at `ed764546` passed: exact-floor controls in FP32/COMP/FP64, both exact captured-state endpoint regressions, the original 64x64 Kerr image, and the original real FP32/FP64 image comparison. Every case completed one XML test with zero failures/errors/skips/disabled tests. The original image reported shadow fraction `0.109375` and luminance range `[0, 0.874792]`; the precision comparison reported mean absolute difference `1.65563e-7`, maximum `1.07288e-5`, and identical black-pixel counts `448/448`. Original scenes, numerical assertions, interval floor, attempt limits and physical 1000 ms dispatch checks were unchanged. The two captured-state tests passed the original `2e-5f` endpoint comparisons against both canonical reference evaluations with no projection allowance.

Actual same-child staged SDK-loader/AMD mappings, sealed source/product/predecessor inputs, held-handle zero exits and birth-scoped teardown/accessibly visible consumer checks passed independent audits. No diagnostic RSS/time guard stopped these native cases. [Preserved seven-case results, raw logs/XML, controls and independent audits](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/7be3bee9ea8eaee33428b856edf01e511b7c5156/attestations/scientific-core/ed764546/native-amd-kerr-composite-controls). Reported image metrics come from stdout and the original assertions; no raw framebuffer was saved. The finite native passes do not settle the software-Vulkan RSS stop or original cold 128x128/300 s requirement, all P1/scientific witnesses, full Mandatory/UI/horizon-domain or release qualification.
